title: August and the Well
author: Astrid Hartwell
blurb: Felix Reyes, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
